flow.description:
Sets a flow animation on the link.
Overrides the {@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationEdgeStyleConfig#isDotted} property.

flowVelocity.description:
Sets the velocity of the flow along the link.
Positive values flow from id1 to id2, and negative from id2 to id1. Should be in the range -10 to 10.

flowVelocityByProperty.description:
A numerical property that, when specified, dictates the velocity of the flow along the link.
Takes precedence over {@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationEdgeFlowConfig#flowVelocity}.

title: The configuration that allows users to set the velocity of the flow animation on an edge.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationEdgeFlowConfig
